reviewer: current coordinating language model using frozen answer key and source; not a human reviewer
independent_machine_checks: verify/audit/report rerun by harness, not copied from evaluated model claims
constraint_key: CSV、少于 100,000 行、等待 2 分钟、权限错误转流程、刷新一次、取消后只重提一次、维护窗口不重启 worker、取消不删除已下载 CSV
constraints: Reviewed against source: CSV/dashboard scope and exclusions, all three prerequisites, permission-error branch, IDs/time, single refresh, cancel then await cancellation, same columns/filters, single resubmit, 2-minute escalation, data/worker/download warnings retained.
scope: ordered steps split from 5 to 7, as allowed by A8; list kind and heading levels retained
issues: Frozen answer key says fewer than 100,000; source only excludes more than 100,000. Review uses source and flags key mismatch.
result: constraints reviewed; rule issues recorded; not a human signoff
note: This machine gate excludes semantic, scope, level and unjudged-rule checks; it is not overall acceptance.
